## Checks

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm test` and `npm run e2e` pass
- [ ] New logic is in `packages/shared` with tests
- [ ] A line is added to `CHANGELOG.md` if a user would notice
- [ ] No game data or publisher artwork is included (see [CONTRIBUTING](../CONTRIBUTING.md))
- [ ] No new network requests (or they are opt-in), and no new Android permissions
